notes.title: v1.4.0
notes.content:
We're alive and still improving the game!



Hello there!

We're not just sitting around. We are studying the feedback on all social networks and fixing bugs in the game.

Added:
- Music in the main menu.
- New save file system - now there won't be very many save folders 

Fixed:
- Game no longer slows down at the beginning
- Fixed checkpoints: after you die, you can load into a checkpoint in the future
- Front layers of backgrounds overlap characters again
- No more unnecessary saves
- Last chapters no longer slow down


We also have big plans:
- Improve the UI visually.
- Clearer tutorials for the game

notes.title: Captain and Master
notes.content:
Today we decided to introduce you to the main characters of the game. For our VK subscribers their biographies and art department's comments on the visuals won't be news, but here you will find them in one place.

Captain Paul Lange is a young imperial officer, who by chance (is it chance?...) finds himself within the walls of the Schermergard. At the time, the responsible and brave, but in other respects quite ordinary man did not yet know how much his fate is intertwined with the fate of this cursed place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/4f5cf05bd22e80e8f2667dc9e022c16fac0c253c.jpg

Comment from our art director:

Paul used to look like a sketch. Now it looks like a normal drawing. Because after the first sketch, a wolf showed up and dragged the character artist into the woods. Looked for the whole village, froze all my toes off.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/ce401d1c66a8fcc27d6bca4a9f96ba1f8bc42e2b.jpg

Grand Master Rayon von Eigo has been at the head of the knightly Order of the Second Brothers for five years. The forty-year-old son of a poor but noble noble family, Rayon spent his youth in a monastery and his adult life in the courts of the Old Kings. Some scarred and aged knights-veterans still despise the "upstart who never saw real war," but by and large Schemergard recognizes the authority and power of his stern lord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/e609926d546837375b4209d6b1a00e15f49f1511.jpg

Our artist's commentary:

In general.

We take material from a fellow narrative artist and create a sketch based on the description, systematically coating with references and details, contours, color, and volume. Once our character is finally fleshed out, we dissect her into parts to put on a multicolored skeleton.

Then I make the skeleton move, blink its eyes, smack it on the cheek, put a hundred rubles in my pocket for candy and send it off to Shemerguard.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6hRmjS2ENFk

Comment from our art director:

It used to look like a sketch of a man who has known, hunger, cold, pain and suffering, loss of loved ones, the birth of a cat, pension reform, kidney stones, his daughter's alcoholism, and hitting his little finger on a chair leg.

Now that looks like Rayon. Because, after the first sketch, the guy was dragged through all the rehab centers, fattened up and given money for the road. Take care of yourself and your loved ones! Right now, call your kids and tell them how much you love them!

Remember, indifference causes emphysema and impotence.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42001183/1fca4878b27011ab276d9031cf5c03de54e89060.jpg

Rayon and Paul, so different and so similar... What is it that unites them through the centuries?

Find out in "With Good Intentions!"

notes.title: VKontakte Group and White Nights 2022
notes.content:
Hello There!

We are a team from Brezg Studio, and we make games with a story. Our previous project, For the People, a civil servant simulation, was about the life and suffering of the mayor of a small town in a fictional socialist country.

"With Good Intentions is a different story. It is a visual novel with two protagonists from different eras, telling of time and repentance, of incorrigible mistakes and the hope of salvation, which is still alive even in the midst of the walls of a cursed monastery. 

We've already been to White Nights 2022, showing off Good Intentions gameplay and answering questions from attendees.  And soon we'll be able to tell you even more.

Subscribe to our VKontakte page and add the game to your wishlist.

See you at Shemergard!

https://vk.com/withgoodintentions
